jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.summary: Build fast, accessible interfaces for client products and help shape our internal design system.
responsibilities: Build responsive interfaces with React and Next.js
Turn design files into polished, accessible components
Review code and improve performance across projects
requirements: Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript
A portfolio or GitHub we can look at

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.summary: Design secure APIs and services that power client platforms, from payments to streaming.
responsibilities: Design and build REST or GraphQL APIs
Model data and write reliable database queries
Own deployment, monitoring and security basics
requirements: Solid SQL and API design knowledge
Care for testing, security and clean architecture

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer
jobs.summary: Ship Android and iOS apps for our clients, from first screen to store release.
responsibilities: Build cross-platform apps with Flutter or React Native
Integrate APIs, push notifications and payments
Prepare and publish releases to the app stores
requirements: Shipped at least one mobile app
Comfortable with state management and REST APIs

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.summary: Turn ideas into clear flows and beautiful screens that people enjoy using.
responsibilities: Run discovery and map user journeys
Design wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity UI
Work with developers to ship what you design
requirements: Strong Figma skills and a portfolio
Clear communication with clients and teammates

jobs.title: Videographer and Editor
jobs.summary: Capture and edit video for client brands, events and our own channels.
responsibilities: Shoot commercials, events and product videos
Edit, colour grade and add motion graphics
requirements: Portfolio of shot and edited work
Experience with Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve
Own camera kit is a plus

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.summary: Plan and run social accounts for our clients and grow their audiences.
responsibilities: Build content calendars and write captions
Manage communities and respond to messages
Report on growth and recommend improvements
requirements: Strong writing and a good eye for visuals
Comfortable with analytics and scheduling tools
